title: You Beckoned

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Oh good, you're here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh good, you're here.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: And like a good little synth-pup you materialized. I have a job for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And like a good little synth-pup you materialized. I have a job for you.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Whatever rocks roll down your river. But before you get lathered in sun screen and picked apart by gulls, I have a job for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever rocks roll down your river. But before you get lathered in sun screen and picked apart by gulls, I have a job for you.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Yes, I know, the finer things in life must be intimidating for someone like you. But! Luck is in your favor. I have a job for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I know, the finer things in life must be intimidating for someone like you. But! Luck is in your favor. I have a job for you.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: For me. I want you to work for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For me. I want you to work for me.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Listen. I'll drop the pretext. We know the goal is to make it to the Spire, and we know there's only a few who are going to get there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen. I'll drop the pretext. We know the goal is to make it to the Spire, and we know there's only a few who are going to get there.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: But for the people who ascend, there are those that help them. Wouldn't you rather be a footnote and an aide than nothing at all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But for the people who ascend, there are those that help them. Wouldn't you rather be a footnote and an aide than nothing at all?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: ... Yes. Assist me with this and I'll bring you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... Yes. Assist me with this and I'll bring you.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Look at that, you're smarter than you seem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look at that, you're smarter than you seem.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: And yet here I am giving you an opportunity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And yet here I am giving you an opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Our annual gala is coming up and our new corporate backers want a, well... I can't believe I'm saying this ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Our annual gala is coming up and our new corporate backers want a, well... I can't believe I'm saying this ...

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: ... For money? Lims. The thing that buys the stuff you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... For money? Lims. The thing that buys the stuff you want?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Neon Gods. The gala is raising money to increase the reserves in accounts I hold across different markets.... IT'S TO MAKE ME RICHER YOU STUPID FUCK.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Neon Gods. The gala is raising money to increase the reserves in accounts I hold across different markets.... IT'S TO MAKE ME RICHER YOU STUPID FUCK.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Listen, the fact is that you can think whatever you want about me, my businesses, my island, whatever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, the fact is that you can think whatever you want about me, my businesses, my island, whatever.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Please. Once people get a taste of what I can offer them they'll eat, drink, do whatever I tell them. I'm a rocket ship and people want to see what space tastes like.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please. Once people get a taste of what I can offer them they'll eat, drink, do whatever I tell them. I'm a rocket ship and people want to see what space tastes like.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Good little synth-pup. I need entertainment. I don't know what these kind of people listen to, what acts will draw them in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good little synth-pup. I need entertainment. I don't know what these kind of people listen to, what acts will draw them in.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Well, you're of the same demographic so I would assume you have the same... tastes... if you can even call it that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you're of the same demographic so I would assume you have the same... tastes... if you can even call it that.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Do not lecture me on how to act towards clients. I know how to run my businesses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do not lecture me on how to act towards clients. I know how to run my businesses.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Are you going to find some musicians or no?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you going to find some musicians or no?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Good, the gala is in ten days. I need someone by then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good, the gala is in ten days. I need someone by then.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Congrats, you can do math. Ten days. Don't disappoint me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Congrats, you can do math. Ten days. Don't disappoint me.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: ... more welcoming environment for people who might not have the opportunity to visit the island otherwise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... more welcoming environment for people who might not have the opportunity to visit the island otherwise.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: But, if you help me do this, then I'll feed the new arrivals to your restaurants.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But, if you help me do this, then I'll feed the new arrivals to your restaurants.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Do you know how much that will increase your business portfolio? Not to mention your revenue?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know how much that will increase your business portfolio? Not to mention your revenue?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How is that lucky for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How is that lucky for me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How is that lucky for me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How is that lucky for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want me to work with you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want me to work with you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want me to work with you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want me to work with you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Being eaten by gulls sounds better than working for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Being eaten by gulls sounds better than working for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Being eaten by gulls sounds better than working for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Being eaten by gulls sounds better than working for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the job?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: .... you can dress the words as nice as you want but the meaning's still there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: .... you can dress the words as nice as you want but the meaning's still there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: .... you can dress the words as nice as you want but the meaning's still there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: .... you can dress the words as nice as you want but the meaning's still there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the gala for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the gala for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's this have to do with me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's this have to do with me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What's this have to do with me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What's this have to do with me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you're still an asshole.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you're still an asshole.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah but gala's usually raise money for a cause.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah but gala's usually raise money for a cause.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah but gala's usually raise money for a cause.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah but gala's usually raise money for a cause.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm not helping you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I'm not helping you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you need me to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you need me to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you need me to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you need me to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you think I do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you think I do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You might have to change your attitude when people are actually here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You might have to change your attitude when people are actually here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You might have to change your attitude when people are actually here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You might have to change your attitude when people are actually here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I can get someone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I can get someone.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I can get someone.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I can get someone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And yet here I am. Beckoned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And yet here I am. Beckoned.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And yet here I am. Beckoned.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And yet here I am. Beckoned.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ten days?! That's not even two weeks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ten days?! That's not even two weeks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ten days?! That's not even two weeks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ten days?! That's not even two weeks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You would bring me to the Corpster level?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You would bring me to the Corpster level?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You would bring me to the Corpster level?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You would bring me to the Corpster level?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the job?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When it comes to you I'd rather be nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When it comes to you I'd rather be nothing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: When it comes to you I'd rather be nothing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: When it comes to you I'd rather be nothing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Unfortunately.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, you beckoned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you beckoned.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Took a vacation day. Figured I'd lie on the beach. Catch some sun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Took a vacation day. Figured I'd lie on the beach. Catch some sun.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Took a vacation day. Figured I'd lie on the beach. Catch some sun.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Took a vacation day. Figured I'd lie on the beach. Catch some sun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I believe you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I won't believe you, either!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I won't believe you, either!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How generous!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How generous!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Exactly!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wouldn't dare ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't dare ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that a threat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that a threat?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that a benefit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that a benefit?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who should I kill?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who should I kill?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You got the wrong person!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got the wrong person!
